tags.name: Black Forest
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. SM Divers confirms 25-40m site range, Advanced/strong currents, marine life (anthias, rockcods/groupers, scorpionfish, squirrelfish, parrotfish, wrasse, damselfish, anemonefish, triggerfish). Alona Divers confirms 35-45m black coral zone, Intermediate-Advanced, marine life (barracudas, trevallies, jackfish, anthias, wrasses, occasional turtles). Live Life confirms jackfish/blackfin barracuda emphasis. No factual claims in the markdown contradicted by current source content; all figures and species held up. No changes made beyond re-verification. Prior 2026-06-25 note: Difficulty upgraded Intermediate→Advanced (SM Divers 'strong currents and excellent buoyancy control required'; Alona Divers Intermediate-Advanced). Hammerhead/manta NOT confirmed at this site.

tags.name: Marine Sanctuary
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. SM Divers confirms 5-25m, Beginner-Advanced, turtles/jackfish/snapper/barracuda/clownfish/butterflyfish/parrotfish. Alona Bohol Divers Club confirms 3-35m, mild current, turtles/jackfish/bluefin trevally/midnight snapper/surgeonfish/lionfish/banana nudibranch/needlefish/triggerfish. Dive Scotty confirms plateau 6-18m with black-forest zone to ~40m, sea turtles/jacks/barracudas/mackerels/eels. All current markdown claims (depth 35m, Beginner rating, species list) remain supported. No changes required. Prior 2026-06-25 note: Depth corrected 30m→35m.

tags.name: Pamilacan Island
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. FINDING — source conflict on Dakit-Dakit difficulty: SM Divers' current page now rates it 'Beginner to experienced / suitable for leisurely drift dives', while Valm Divers rates it 'Intermediate to advanced (drift diving required)'. This is a change/discrepancy from the prior audit's characterization of Dakit-Dakit as uniformly Advanced-only. Per policy, conflict is flagged in the markdown rather than silently resolved. Aggregate difficulty kept at Advanced because it covers 5 named sub-sites and Spanish Tower is consistently rated Advanced by SM Divers ('stronger currents, ideal for drift diving') — using the most demanding sub-site is the conservative choice for a multi-site aggregate entry. Manta rays and eagle rays reconfirmed at Spanish Tower by SM Divers and Valm Divers. Whale sharks: SM Divers' current Spanish Tower listing now explicitly names 'whale sharks during certain times of year' at that specific site (single source, hedged) — added to markdown as an occasional/unconfirmed-regular sighting, attributed to SM Divers only. Prior 2026-06-25 note: Difficulty upgraded Intermediate→Advanced; manta/whale shark claims stripped as unconfirmed at site level.

tags.name: Doljo Point
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. SM Divers confirms shallow plateau 5-12m, wall zone 18-30m, max depth 'well past 60 meters', Advanced Open Water best suited, monsoon shelter, and marine life list matches current markdown EXACTLY (gorgonian sea fans, giant barrel sponges, giant frogfish, nudibranchs Chromodoris/Flabellina, ghost pipefish, surgeonfish, batfish, sweetlips, trevally, dogtooth tuna, eagle rays, reef sharks, chevron barracuda). Valm Divers confirms wall to 80m/dives limited to 40m, Intermediate-Advanced, plus additional species (triggerfish, pufferfish, moray eels, elephant ear/tube sponges/corals) not previously listed — left out of markdown since a single source is an acceptable bar but these are additive, not corrective; no conflict to resolve. Alona Bohol Divers Club confirms 5-35m, Intermediate-Advanced, steep slope, strong current sometimes. No factual claims in the markdown contradicted. No changes required. Prior 2026-06-25 note: Difficulty upgraded Intermediate→Advanced; hammerhead/manta removed as unconfirmed.

tags.name: Kalipayan Wall
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19 — CORRECTION: Difficulty changed Beginner→Intermediate. Fresh re-pull of Alona Bohol Divers Club now explicitly rates the site 'Intermediate to advanced (reaches 32m max depth)', conflicting with the prior audit's Beginner call. Tropical Divers' page (re-fetched) gives depth 'maximum 30 meters' without an explicit skill rating; Valm Divers gives 'maximum 30 meters', also no explicit rating. Per the destination's own difficulty rubric (18-30m = Intermediate), a confirmed 30-32m max depth does not support a Beginner-only tag even though the upper wall (3-20m) is beginner-accessible. Set to Intermediate as the conservative, source-supported minimum; markdown now notes the shallow upper wall is beginner-friendly while the site overall is rated Intermediate by operators. Depth corrected 30m→32m per Alona Bohol Divers Club's explicit max-depth figure. Marine life reconfirmed across three re-pulled sources: batfish, lionfish, nudibranchs, ghost pipefish, dragon seamoth, seahorses, soft corals. Stonefish remains unconfirmed by a third source — kept as 'reported' language, not stated as confirmed.

tags.name: Arco Point
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. SM Divers confirms tunnel entrance 8-9m / exit 18m exactly as stated, sweeper+cardinal fish inside, painted/warty frogfish, banded sea kraits, nudibranchs (Chromodoris/Flabellina), yellow-edged/snowflake/ribbon eels, sponge crabs, cuttlefish/octopus on night dives. Alona Bohol Divers Club (re-pulled) confirms 4-30m depth, mild current/drift, and independently corroborates ghost pipefish, wrasse, triggerfish, butterflyfish, moray eel, banded sea snake, frogfish, and — notably — blue ring octopus and orangutan/porcelain crab, giving blue-ring octopus a second independent source (previously only one). Alona Divers (re-pulled) confirms 4-27m depth, Open Water+ difficulty, southward drift current, does not name species. All current markdown claims remain accurate; blue-ring octopus language can now read as source-confirmed-but-uncommon rather than purely speculative. No other changes required. Prior 2026-06-25 note: swim-through direction corrected; whale shark claim stripped as single-source aggregator only.

tags.name: Snake Island
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-19: Re-pulled all three sources fresh. SM Divers confirms plateau top 12-15m, max depth 60m+, Advanced/strong sweeping currents, distance ~9km SE of Alona Beach, and now explicitly lists 'occasional whale sharks and manta rays' at this site (single source) alongside sea kraits, nudibranchs, moray eels, butterflyfish, sea urchins, bucket sponges, soft corals, feather stars. Dive Scotty confirms strong surface current mellowing with depth, sea snakes, white-eyed/starry moray eels, nudibranchs, 'potential sightings of sharks and dolphins.' Valm Divers confirms strong drift, shoal top ~8m (source gives a slightly shallower plateau-top figure than SM Divers' 12-15m — both cited, treated as a minor rounding/measurement difference rather than a substantive conflict since both describe the same shallow plateau feature), sea kraits, moray eels. Added: occasional whale shark/manta ray mention (SM Divers only, hedged as not-guaranteed) since previous 'sharks, dolphins' language undersold what the primary Cervera Shoal source now states. No other changes required. Prior 2026-06-25 note: MAJOR CORRECTION — difficulty upgraded Beginner→Advanced; site_type changed reef→drift; thresher shark claim removed as unconfirmed (Malapascua phenomenon).
